title: GitHub account
intro: Eldritch Launcher shows a one-time code. Enter it on GitHub to authorise access, then return here.
requestingCode: Requesting a sign-in code from GitHub...
enterCode: Enter this code on GitHub to authorise Eldritch Launcher:
openFailed: Could not open your browser. Visit {{url}} and enter the code.
waiting: Waiting for you to authorise on GitHub. The code expires in {{time}}.
codeExpired: This code has expired. Cancel and start again to get a new code.
installing: Finish installing the GitHub App in your browser. Eldritch Launcher detects the new installation automatically.

configuration.clientIdMissing: GitHub App client ID not configured

errors.expired: The sign-in request expired before it was confirmed. Start again to get a new code.
errors.deviceFlowDisabled: Device sign-in is disabled for this GitHub App. Enable Device Flow in the GitHub App settings.
errors.network: Could not reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unavailable: GitHub is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.notConfigured: This build has no GitHub App configured.

disconnect.openRevocation: Also open GitHub to revoke Eldritch Launcher's authorisation.
disconnect.openRevocationDetail: GitHub opens its authorised GitHub Apps page. Revoke Eldritch Launcher there to sign out every device.
disconnect.localOnlyDetail: Only this device is signed out. The GitHub authorisation stays active on other devices until you revoke it on GitHub.
